headline: Golden Disc Awards name first 12 acts for Hanoi show
sub: CORTIS, TWS, ZEROBASEONE and TXT's YEONJUN on the lineup

points.title: First lineup
items: ALPHA DRIVE ONE, AND2BLE, A2O LITE

caption:
The 41st Golden Disc Awards just revealed its first performer lineup, and it's packed with this year's hottest names.

Organizer HLL announced 12 acts for the ceremony on Jan 9-10, 2027 at an outdoor stage at VEC in Hanoi, Vietnam: A2O LITE, ALLDAY PROJECT, ALPHA DRIVE ONE, AND2BLE, CORTIS, Hearts2Hearts, KiiiKiii, RESCENE, TWS, YENA, TXT's YEONJUN and ZEROBASEONE. Sung Si-kyung and Moon Ga-young return as hosts. More lineup reveals are expected.

📌 Source: HLL, via Korean media (Single List, AP News Korea)
